rounds.text: Omni Axs Software Ltd is significantly undervalued by the market, trading at a steep discount with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.45x against a book value of ₹ 6.66 per share [E1]. This deep discount is further emphasized by a favorable comparative P/B of 0.53x against its sector benchmark of 2.08x [E6]. Beneath this low valuation lies an accelerating earnings profile, demonstrated by a solid 17% compounded profit growth over 3 years [E17] and a 14% profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E18]. This recent profit momentum is paired with consistent top-line expansion, evidenced by a 10% compounded sales growth over the past 3 years [E13]. Furthermore, patient long-term investors have already been rewarded with a compounded share price growth of 20% over 10 years [E19] and a 16% gain over the past 1 year [E22]. Conceded: [E3], [E4], [E7], [E8], [E14], [E15], [E57].
